04 / DAILY PLANA comfortable pace

OCT 01

Arrive in Budapest · Castle Hill & the Danube

A gentle first day after the overnight flight: one hilltop area, plenty of rest, and an optional evening on the river.

  • 07:00 CEST CA719 arrives at Budapest Airport T2B. Allow time for immigration, baggage and the onward transfer; sightseeing starts only after you have rested.
  • 09:00–10:30 target CEST Reach Hotel GIN, request luggage storage and have breakfast nearby. Early room access is not guaranteed; ask reception about the booked check-in time.
  • 12:30 CEST A light lunch and a rest. If you are still tired, skip the palace courtyards and go straight to Fisherman’s Bastion later.
  • 14:00 CEST Travel to Buda Castle; allow roughly 30–45 minutes including the uphill approach. Walk the public courtyards and viewpoints where accessible; follow any construction diversions.
  • 15:15 CEST Walk through the Castle District towards Matthias Church, about 20–30 minutes with photo stops. Enjoy the colourful roof and exterior; an interior visit needs its own opening-time and ticket check.
  • 16:00–17:00 CEST Fisherman’s Bastion: terraces, arches and Danube views. Choose the public areas; check charges before entering paid upper terraces.
  • 17:30–18:30 CEST Return towards Hotel GIN, rest and have dinner. Do not turn the downhill journey into another long sightseeing loop.
  • 19:30 target CEST Optional Danube riverside stroll or a sightseeing cruise if you still have energy. OPTIONAL · NOT BOOKED For a cruise, book an actual departure and use the operator’s stated pier, arriving 20–30 minutes early; the linked square is not a confirmed boarding point.

Easy alternative: make this an afternoon Bastion visit plus dinner, with no cruise. Castle District context. All non-flight times are suggested local windows.

OCT 02

Budapest & Louis Vuitton hot stamping

  • 09:00 CEST Breakfast and a short browse at Central Market Hall. Allow about 30 minutes afterwards to reach the boutique by city transport.
  • 10:30 CEST Louis Vuitton Budapest — ask for the Budapest Parliament-building hot stamp on your LV passport cover. CONFIRM SERVICE AHEAD Allow 45–60 minutes for the enquiry; the completion time is up to the store.
  • 12:00 CEST Lunch and an exterior stop at the Hungarian State Opera nearby.
  • 13:30 CEST Hungarian Parliament exterior and riverside walk. An interior tour is optional and needs a separate reservation; it is not booked.
  • 14:30 CEST Shoes on the Danube Bank memorial; leave time for a quiet riverside stop.
  • 15:30 CEST St. Stephen’s Basilica and a café. Keep the late afternoon flexible for a return to LV if collection is needed.
  • 17:30 CEST Optional return to LV only if the store has confirmed your item is ready. Collect before closing; tomorrow’s train leaves at 07:30 CEST.

LV visit: Andrássy út 24, 1061 Budapest · Official store & appointment · +36 1 373 0487. Listed Friday hours: 10:00–19:00 CEST. Hot stamping is listed, but the Parliament motif, item eligibility, any fee and same-day completion must be confirmed. Bring your LV passport cover and a reference image. Do not leave it overnight without a collection plan before departure.

Ask: “Could you hot-stamp the Budapest Parliament motif on my passport cover? Is this item eligible, and can I collect it today?”

OCT 03

Budapest → St. Wolfgang · travel & lakeside rest

The long transfer is today’s main event. Keep the afternoon local and leave mountain activities for tomorrow.

  • 07:30 CEST Budapest-Keleti → St. Wolfgang. TICKET ISSUED Aim to leave Hotel GIN around 06:15 CEST and be at Keleti by 06:45 CEST. Pack breakfast and water the night before.
  • Morning–afternoon CEST Follow the issued connection: RJX 60 → IC 640 → REX 70 → bus 546. Keep all ticket segments together and check each change on the operator’s app; this is not one direct train.
  • 12:58–13:08 CEST Attnang-Puchheim Bahnhof transfer shown in your route screenshot: 10 minutes. Keep luggage ready and check the platform before arrival. If disrupted, ask railway staff for the valid onward connection rather than guessing.
  • 14:03–14:38 CEST The supplied route reaches Bad Ischl Bahnhof at 14:03 CEST, then connects to bus 546 for St. Wolfgang Markt (Pilgergasse), arriving at 14:38 CEST. Follow any updates on the issued ticket; stop arrival is not hotel check-in.
  • 15:00–15:45 target CEST Continue to Strandhotel Margaretha, check in and put your bags down. Allow about 20–30 minutes with luggage from the village stop, or arrange a local transfer if needed.
  • 16:00–17:00 CEST An easy village walk: St. Wolfgang parish church exterior and the nearby market streets. Pause for coffee rather than starting another excursion.
  • 17:00–18:00 CEST Wolfgangsee waterfront: lakeside photos and a slow walk back towards the hotel. Watch for reflections and changing mountain light; sunset colour is weather-dependent.
  • 18:30–20:00 CEST Dinner, then confirm tomorrow’s mountain-rail return slot, ferry connection and luggage arrangements. An early night will make the summit morning easier.

Connection rule: the purchased ticket and live operator information govern. Do not add sightseeing at transfer stations. Regional bus timetables.

OCT 04

Schafberg · lake crossing · Salzburg

A summit morning followed by a one-way lake journey. The weather, reserved return train and onward connection set the pace.

  • 07:45–08:30 CEST Breakfast and check out at Strandhotel Margaretha. Arrange luggage storage and collection with reception before leaving; carry warm layers, water and grippy shoes.
  • 08:45 CEST Reach SchafbergBahn valley station; check the summit forecast and operation. Allow time to collect tickets and find your boarding queue.
  • 09:15 target CEST Take the cog railway to Schafbergspitze. RESERVATION NEEDED The 2026 timetable lists a 09:15 CEST ascent; reserve both the ascent and descent. This is a suggested slot, not a ticket confirmation.
  • 10:00–11:15 CEST A short summit circuit and a drink if available. Stay on signed paths and viewpoints; no cliff-edge scramble or long summit hike is part of this plan.
  • Late morning–12:45 CEST Descend on your reserved train, aiming to be back in the village by about 12:45 CEST. If only a later descent is available, shorten the lake stop or transfer directly to Salzburg.
  • 12:45–13:45 CEST Lunch and collect luggage. Check your actual ferry departure from St. Wolfgang Schafbergbahn pier; confirm luggage carriage with the operator.
  • 13:45–15:30 window CEST Take an available ferry towards St. Gilgen pier and enjoy the Wolfgangsee crossing. CHECK SAILING · NOT BOOKED Use the Sunday late-season timetable. This window is not a guaranteed departure; allow time to walk to the bus stop with bags.
  • 15:30–18:00 window CEST St. Gilgen Busbahnhof → Salzburg on a suitable line 150 connection, then Hotel Villa Carlton. Reserve roughly two hours for bus waiting, travel and the hotel transfer; the actual connection governs.
  • 18:30 CEST Dinner near the hotel and a relaxed evening. If the mountain railway or ferry is cancelled, use the local bus connection via Strobl to Salzburg and arrive earlier.

Do not squeeze both activities into poor weather. Summit visibility can be very different from the lakeshore. 2026 railway & ferry timetable · Bus 150 / 546 connections. The official railway timetable may change or lose services in poor weather.

OCT 05

Hallstatt · village lanes & lakeside views

A full public-transport day trip with a compact village walk. Choose one optional extra, not a second lake or mountain.

  • 07:00–07:30 target CEST Breakfast and leave Hotel Villa Carlton for Salzburg Hauptbahnhof. Choose the outward and return connections together the evening before; all times below are planning windows.
  • 07:30–10:30 window CEST Travel towards Hallstatt Lahn. Allow about 2½–3½ hours each way with connections. One option is line 150 to Bad Ischl, then the regional bus connection via Gosaumühle; another is train to Hallstatt station plus its village ferry. Do not confuse the opposite-bank railway station with the village.
  • 10:30–11:15 target CEST Walk through the waterfront lanes towards Classic Village Viewpoint. If arriving at Lahn, allow 25–35 minutes through town with stops. Photograph the church spire and lake from public space.
  • 11:15–12:00 CEST Return towards Hallstatt Market Square and the Evangelical Church exterior. Browse the small lanes without entering private stairways or gardens.
  • 12:00–13:00 CEST Sit down for lunch in the village. Keep time for queues and use a simple café meal if restaurants are busy.
  • 13:00–14:30 CEST A slower walk south along the lake towards Hallstatt Lahn, with benches, reflections and a coffee stop. Leave the faraway Dachstein Five Fingers and Gosausee for another trip.
  • 14:30–15:15 CEST Final photos, restroom and a small snack for the journey. Recheck your return bus or ferry/train connection before wandering farther.
  • 15:30–16:00 target CEST Start the return to Salzburg Hauptbahnhof; aim to be back around 18:30–19:30 CEST, depending on the chosen services. Do not rely on the last connection of the day.
  • 19:30 CEST Dinner and rest near Villa Carlton. Check tomorrow’s Königssee boat operations and cross-border bus connection.

Optional replacement, not an add-on: if you want the salt mine / Skywalk, check Salzwelten’s current opening and tickets and replace much of the village afternoon with it. Do not assume an old renovation notice or a map listing reflects current access. The base plan stays lakeside. Hallstatt bus-arrival guide · Village photo point · Station ferry.

OCT 06

Königssee · boat ride & St. Bartholomä

A lake-and-boat day in Germany. St. Bartholomä is the relaxed main plan; Obersee is an optional early-start alternative.

  • 07:30–08:00 target CEST Leave Villa Carlton with your passport, water, a snack and a warm waterproof layer. Choose an early public-transport connection; Germany and Austria both use CEST on this date.
  • 08:00–10:00 window CEST Travel via Berchtesgaden ZOB towards Königssee Seelände. Use the current line 840 timetable; some journeys may require a change at Berchtesgaden. Allow 1½–2½ hours including waiting and the walk to the pier.
  • 10:00–10:30 target CEST Reach the boat area, use the restroom and check the day’s return schedule before joining the queue. Aim for an early departure to preserve a calm afternoon.
  • 10:30 target CEST Königssee boat departure → St. Bartholomä, roughly 35 minutes on the water. BOOK AHEAD · NOT BOOKED Pick an actual available outward slot; the target time is not a sailing reservation.
  • 11:15–12:15 CEST Explore the red-domed church exterior and nearby signed lakeside paths at St. Bartholomä. Keep this a short walk; do not start the strenuous mountain route back.
  • 12:15–13:00 CEST Lunch or a packed snack in an appropriate area. Keep rubbish with you and leave time to queue for the return boat.
  • 13:30–14:30 window CEST Take a suitable return boat to Seelände. The main plan returns well before the final service so there is slack for queues and the onward bus.
  • 15:00–17:30 window CEST Return through Berchtesgaden to Salzburg Hauptbahnhof, then the hotel. A coffee stop is optional only if the next connection leaves comfortable time.
  • 18:30 CEST An easy dinner, then pack for tomorrow’s train to Vienna. Keep the evening close to Villa Carlton.

Obersee alternative: only with an early arrival, good weather and enough return margin, go first to Salet (about an hour by boat) and walk to the near shore of Obersee; shorten or skip the St. Bartholomä stop. No far-end waterfall hike is included. For Oct 06, the published last return is 17:10 CEST from Salet and 17:30 CEST from St. Bartholomä—emergency limits, not your targets. There is no continuous lakeside walking route back. 2026 boat timetable · Boat FAQ · Cross-border bus timetables.

OCT 07

Arrive in Vienna · Prater & Before Sunrise

An easy arrival evening: hotel first, then the Giant Ferris Wheel and Prater lights. Sunset is a bonus, not a deadline.

  • 09:00 CEST A short Mirabell Gardens walk and coffee if your departure time allows. Collect luggage from Hotel Villa Carlton and follow your issued train ticket; leave a station buffer.
  • 16:47 CEST Arrive at Wien Hauptbahnhof, on your issued Salzburg–Vienna train. TICKET ISSUED Arrival time supplied in your updated itinerary; the ticket and live railway notices govern.
  • 17:00–17:30 target CEST Start your first 24h Digital WIEN before boarding. Travel towards MAXX: tram 18 towards Burggasse-Stadthalle / Westbahnhof, alight at Margaretengürtel station Vienna and walk to the hotel. Allow station exit, waiting and luggage time; check the live route.
  • 17:30–17:55 target CEST Check in, leave luggage and freshen up. If delayed, shorten the later park walk instead of rushing the transfer.
  • 17:55–18:40 window CEST Travel to Praterstern Vienna: a useful route is U4 from Margaretengürtel to Schwedenplatz, then U1 towards Leopoldau to Praterstern. Walk to Wiener Riesenrad. Allow 35–45 minutes door to entrance.
  • 18:30–19:30 target CEST Wiener Riesenrad — the signature Before Sunrise stop. NOT BOOKED Book an official dated ticket and allow for the boarding queue; it does not guarantee a sunset boarding time.
  • 19:30–20:30 CEST An unhurried Prater walk: vintage fairground atmosphere, lights and a few photos. Individual attractions have their own hours and tickets.
  • 20:30 onwards CEST Dinner, then return to MAXX by city transport. No museum, old-town shopping circuit or second major attraction tonight.
Vienna city passes · €38.80 planned for two

Pass 1, per person: Oct 07 17:00 → Oct 08 17:00 CEST (UTC+02:00).

Set both start times in advance. Validity is 24 consecutive hours, not a calendar day. Airport travel outside the Vienna core zone needs an additional appropriate ticket; the Giant Ferris Wheel and palace are not included.

Official ticket & conditions

Sunset on Oct 07 is approximately 18:21 CEST. With a 16:47 CEST train arrival, boarding the wheel before sunset is uncertain; arriving during twilight is still worthwhile. Check the wheel’s date-specific opening calendar rather than assuming today’s closing time applies in October. Official tickets · Film locations · Sunset table.

OCT 08

Schönbrunn · film cafés · shopping · blue hour

The main Vienna day: palace morning, café and neighbourhoods, then focused shopping. Protect the Votivkirche photo window by dropping the optional record shop if needed.

  • 08:10–08:15 CEST Leave MAXX for Schönbrunn Palace Vienna. Walk to Margaretengürtel, take U4 towards Hütteldorf to Schönbrunn, then walk to the entrance. Allow 25–40 minutes door to palace, not just the train ride.
  • 08:40–09:00 target CEST Reach the palace entrance, use the restroom and prepare your timed-entry ticket.
  • 09:00–10:10 target CEST Schönbrunn Palace interior. RESERVATION NEEDED Aim to reserve two Palace Tickets around 09:00 CEST; this is not a confirmed entry. Adjust the rest of the morning to the actual tour duration.
  • 10:10–11:15 CEST Great Parterre Schönbrunn → Neptune Fountain Schönbrunn → palace views. A short garden walk is enough; the full Gloriette climb is optional only if well ahead of time.
  • 11:15–11:45 CEST Travel towards Café Sperl, using U4 to Kettenbrückengasse and walking. Do not return to the hotel.
  • 11:45–12:30 CEST Lunch or coffee at Café Sperl, a Before Sunrise location. If there is a long wait, choose a nearby lunch and keep the route moving.
  • 12:40–13:10 CEST Spittelberg Vienna: cobbled lanes, old façades and small shops. Continue on foot towards Neubaugasse.
  • 13:15–14:00 CEST FREITAG Store Wien. Leave 40–45 minutes to compare bags; the listed Thursday hours are 10:00–18:00 CEST.
  • 14:00–14:30 CEST Optional Teuchtler – Alt & Neu record shop, another film location. Check opening before going and ask before taking photos. It is a small detour back towards Mariahilf; skip it if serious shopping is the priority.
  • 14:30–15:00 CEST Walk via MuseumsQuartier Vienna towards Hofburg Vienna and Michaelerplatz Vienna. These are exterior stops, not additional museum visits.
  • 15:00–17:15 CEST Kohlmarkt Vienna + Graben Vienna: the main shopping window. Add Stephansplatz Vienna only if time remains. If skipping the record shop, start this section about 30 minutes earlier.
  • 17:00 CEST Your second 24h Digital WIEN starts at its preset time, exactly when the first expires. Set this in advance; you do not need to interrupt shopping to activate it manually.
  • 17:15–17:50 CEST Stop shopping and walk to Votivkirche. Allow 25–35 minutes from Graben, longer if finishing at Stephansplatz; use city transport if carrying heavy bags.
  • 17:50–18:50 CEST Votivkirche exterior photography only. Scout your position first; protect 18:15–18:40 CEST for sunset and the transition into blue hour. No interior visit or indoor light-show ticket is planned.
  • 19:00 onwards CEST Dinner, with an optional short Rathaus Vienna → Burgtheater Vienna / Ringstraße night walk. If tired or carrying purchases, return directly to MAXX.

Oct 08 sunset is approximately 18:19 CEST, with civil twilight ending around 18:50 CEST; weather affects the colour. The exterior light installation Infinity of Light has been announced through May 2027, but an exact nightly switch-on time is not confirmed here. The existing photograph shows the church, not a guarantee of the current installation. This is separate from the indoor Light of Creation show. Installation announcement · Sunset table · Palace hours · FREITAG hours · Film locations. Naschmarkt is not scheduled in this version; Café Sperl is the lunch stop.

OCT 09

Parliament · a final city walk · airport

A free Parliament tour if reserved, then a compact farewell walk. Finish lunch early enough to collect luggage and reach the airport by 16:00 CEST.

  • 08:30–09:30 CEST Breakfast, check out of MAXX and arrange luggage storage with reception. Carry official photo ID for Parliament; do not take large suitcases to the tour.
  • 09:30–10:20 CEST Travel towards Volkstheater station Vienna, then walk to Austrian Parliament. If ahead of time, photograph Rathaus or Burgtheater exteriors; do not try to cover all three before security.
  • 10:20–10:30 CEST Be at the visitor entrance behind the Pallas Athena fountain for ID and security checks, at least 15 minutes before a booked 10:45 CEST tour.
  • 10:45–11:40 target CEST English guided Parliament tour, about 55 minutes and free. FREE · RESERVATION NEEDED Reserve two places; no booking is confirmed here. If unavailable or cancelled, keep an exterior visit instead of adding another timed attraction.
  • 11:45–12:45 CEST A compact exterior walk: Volksgarten Vienna → Heldenplatz Vienna / Hofburg Vienna → Albertina Vienna → Kärntner Straße Vienna. Choose a short shopping top-up instead if needed; do not add Belvedere or another museum entry.
  • 12:45–13:30 CEST Lunch near the centre. Finish by 13:30 CEST; shopping and sightseeing end here.
  • 13:30–14:00 CEST Return to MAXX, collect luggage and check passports, tickets and belongings.
  • 14:00–14:30 CEST Travel to Wien Hauptbahnhof. Tram 18 towards Stadion is a useful low-change option; check the live stop and service. Your second city pass still covers travel within Vienna.
  • 14:45–15:30 departure window CEST Take a suitable direct ÖBB Railjet / other valid airport service to Flughafen Wien Bahnhof. The train ride can be about 15 minutes, but allow waiting, platform access and the walk to Terminal 3. Choose the actual service in ÖBB’s planner and buy the appropriate airport ticket.
  • By 16:00 CEST Reach Vienna Airport Terminal 3 for check-in, baggage and security, three hours before departure. Leave earlier for VAT-refund formalities or disruption; do not plan around the last possible train.
  • 19:00 CEST CA618 departs Vienna T3. CONFIRMED · FLIGHT
  • Oct 10 · CST (UTC+08:00) Arrive Beijing at 10:20 CST; CA1533 departs at 12:30 CST and arrives Shanghai Hongqiao T2 at 14:45 CST.

Parliament reservations open 28 days ahead; the Oct 09 booking window is already open. Carry official photo ID; large luggage cannot be stored at Parliament. The airport is outside the city-pass core zone. Book a valid Wien Hbf–Flughafen Wien ticket; only select a city-zone deduction if the seller explicitly offers it for your existing pass and chosen service. Airport fares are not yet recorded as paid. Tour booking · Visitor access · ÖBB airport connection · Airport arrival guidance.

05 / BEFORE YOU GOA shared list, not browser checkboxes

  • Buy four personal 24h Digital WIEN tickets (two per traveller), starting Oct 07 and Oct 08 at 17:00 CEST respectively. Airport tickets are separate; these are planned purchases, not paid costs.
  • Book the Giant Ferris Wheel for Oct 07 and check that date’s opening calendar. Check optional Teuchtler shop opening before visiting.
  • Contact Louis Vuitton Budapest before Oct 02: confirm the Parliament hot stamp, passport-cover eligibility, any fee and same-day collection.
  • Reserve two Schönbrunn Palace Tickets for Oct 08 (target 09:00 CEST).
  • Reserve the free Austrian Parliament tour for Oct 09 (target 10:45 CEST); booking opens 28 days ahead. Bring photo ID and arrange luggage storage at MAXX.
  • Reserve Schafberg ascent and descent together; confirm the Oct 04 Sunday ferry and luggage plan. Book the Königssee outward boat and check the return schedule.
  • Download the issued Oct 03 and Oct 07 rail tickets; follow their exact times and arrival stations.
  • Choose and save the Oct 05 Hallstatt and Oct 06 Königssee outward and return connections. Do not rely on the last bus or boat.
  • Check passports, entry rules, insurance and overseas-card payments; save the handbook offline.

06 / PRACTICAL NOTESLeave a little room for a smooth trip

Connections and time zones: China legs use CST; Europe uses CEST. Reduce the first day if the overnight flight catches up with you.
Mountain-lake weather: October can be much cooler after sunset. Pack a waterproof shell and warm layer; switch to a lakeside walk if summit visibility is poor.
Transport buffer: Allow station walking time and delays on intercity days. Recheck boat and mountain-rail operations the evening before.
Carry-on safety: Watch bags at stations and crowded sights. Keep cash, cards and documents separately, with an offline copy of essentials.
Offline first · Reconfirm operating details with providers before leaving.
